newsitem.title: USA: Angeles, Insignia unit to merge.
newsitem.headline: Angeles, Insignia unit to merge.

text.p: Angeles Mortgage Investment Trust and Insignia Financial Group Inc said they have signed a non-binding deal to merge Angeles Mortgage with Insignia unit Insignia Properties Trust.

Under the deal, which was announced late on Thursday, Angeles Mortgage will issue Class A shares, valued at $16.25 per share, for all the stock of Insignia Properties. The total value of the deal is about $190 million.
The merged company would be 82 percent owned by Insignia and its affiliates and 18 percent by Angeles Mortgage shareholders. It would have net assets of about $230 million.
Angeles Mortgage and Insignia Properties are real estate investment trusts.

The proposed merger is contingent on satisfactory review of the business, operations, properties and assets of the two companies, the negotiation of a definitive agreement and government and shareholder approval, among other items.
